title: Speak to your coursemates! #engineering #engineeringstudent #motivation #electricalengineering
transcript: At university, you have a cohort of students. In your cohort of students, there is always a top 5% of students. Those are the students you should be speaking to. If you're not part of the top 5%, maybe ask yourself why. And if you can't figure that out, maybe ask them what they're doing. Some great questions you can ask: How are they studying? How did they land their internship? How was their interview process like? How many stages did they have? How did they prepare? These are all very valuable things, way more specific to what I can tell you right now, because they're in your shoes exactly.
